# Platform Health Dashboard

Real-time visibility into CPU, memory, disk, and network health across all platform VMs and infrastructure.

Use the **TimeRange** parameter to adjust the monitoring window.

content.query:
Perf
| where ObjectName == 'Processor' and CounterName == '% Processor Time' and InstanceName == '_Total'
| summarize AvgCPU = avg(CounterValue), MaxCPU = max(CounterValue) by Computer
| order by MaxCPU desc
| project Computer, ['Avg CPU (%)'] = round(AvgCPU, 2), ['Max CPU (%)'] = round(MaxCPU, 2), Status = iff(MaxCPU > 90, '🔴 Critical', iff(MaxCPU > 75, '🟡 Warning', '🟢 OK'))
content.title: CPU Utilization by VM

content.query:
Perf
| where ObjectName == 'Memory' and CounterName in ('Available MBytes', '% Available Memory')
| summarize AvailableMB = avgif(CounterValue, CounterName == 'Available MBytes'), AvailPct = avgif(CounterValue, CounterName == '% Available Memory') by Computer
| project Computer, ['Available Memory (MB)'] = round(AvailableMB, 0), ['Available (%)'] = round(AvailPct, 2), Status = iff(AvailPct < 10, '🔴 Critical', iff(AvailPct < 20, '🟡 Warning', '🟢 OK'))
content.title: Memory Utilization by VM

content.query:
Perf
| where ObjectName == 'LogicalDisk' and CounterName == '% Free Space' and InstanceName !in ('HarddiskVolume1', '_Total')
| summarize MinFreeSpace = min(CounterValue) by Computer, InstanceName
| where MinFreeSpace < 20
| project Computer, Drive = InstanceName, ['Free Space (%)'] = round(MinFreeSpace, 2), Status = iff(MinFreeSpace < 10, '🔴 Critical', '🟡 Warning')
| order by ['Free Space (%)'] asc
content.title: Disk Space Warnings (< 20% Free)

content.query:
Heartbeat
| summarize LastHeartbeat = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer, OSType, Version
| extend TimeSinceHeartbeat = now() - LastHeartbeat
| project Computer, OSType, Version, LastHeartbeat, ['Minutes Since Heartbeat'] = round(TimeSinceHeartbeat / 1m, 1), Status = iff(TimeSinceHeartbeat > 10m, '🔴 Agent Down', '🟢 Connected')
| order by ['Minutes Since Heartbeat'] desc
content.title: Agent Heartbeat Status
